title: Vocabulary
description:
A word Varuna has learned, and what understanding it opens. Language is an exploration mechanic rather than flavour: an inscription, an NPC's aside or a place name can all be unreadable until the word is held.

One record is one word. A language is the set of words sharing a `language` value, so fluency is emergent rather than a level.

language.description: Language id -- e.g. kia, harappan, naga. Shared by every word in it.

learned_from.description: npc, point_of_interest or discovery ids that can teach it.

literal.description: The word taken apart, where that is the interesting bit -- a place name that turns out to describe what happened there.
